items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Now I just saw this piece here about Gailers Boyd, I guess you heard of that.

ctx.x: The record stock orchestration that they drive? That's right. New York?
Yeah. He used to get his music from New York. Now I just saw this piece here about Gailers Boyd, I guess you heard of that. Gailers March? Yeah. Gailers March, you know. Yeah. He had that.
